title.narrative: Cities 4 Women: Inclusive and Climate-Resilient Urbanization in Nepal

description.narrative: The 'Cities 4 Women: Inclusive and Climate-Resilient Urbanization in Nepal' project is jointly implemented by UNOPS, UN-Habitat and Cities Alliance. With funding from the European Union and the government of Finland, the project is guided by the steering committee led by Nepal's Ministry of Urban Development.\n\nThe project focuses on inclusive and climate-resilient urbanization in seven municipalities of Nepal: Birendranagar, Chandragiri, Dhanghadi, Hetauda, Sunwal, Tansen and Tilottama as well as sub-metropolitan cities. The overarching strategy is to strengthen institutions with capacity building and tools for transformative, resilient and sustainable urbanization with a goal to mainstream gender into urban planning, design and budgeting.
